claims.quote: RotaTeq is approved for use in infants 6 weeks to 32 weeks of age.

claims.text: Vaxchora (cholera): age 2-64 traveling to cholera-affected areas.
claims.quote: VAXCHORA is approved for use in persons 2 through 64 years of age traveling to cholera-affected areas.

claims.text: Typhoid vaccine: travelers to endemic areas, esp South Asia, or w health/travel risks elsewhere.
claims.quote: Typhoid vaccination is recommended for travelers to endemic areas, particularly those traveling to South Asia and those with health- or travel-related risks traveling to other endemic areas.
